browser_qa.tool: supported cua_repl cloud browser, separate tab
flows: Five untrimmed warm stems score 85/100; ideal dome trimming changes them to 100/100 and creates 70 cm cutoffs.
Keyboard Home on the cream-stem slider trims its 50 cm length to 24 cm, visibly changes composition and score to 96/100; Undo restores 100/100 and cutoffs.
Recycling 15 cm changes cutoffs 70 to 55, reused length to 15, and coins 4 to 5; purchasing one sage stem returns coins to 4, purchases 1/4 and available stock 20.
SVG export produced an actual browser download; downloaded XML parsed successfully with viewBox 0 0 560 540 and 61 elements.
Delivery disables flower positions and locks the order, showing 1/3 delivered.

Second and third simultaneous morning commissions completed at 100/100 from remaining shared stock. Terminal result shows 3/3 delivered, average 100, reused 15 cm and 10 stems remaining (one restock was exercised).
Next-market button opens rainy scenario with an independent 24-stem stock.
Free composition shows infinity instead of scoring; a two-stem arrangement survives page reload.
Switching back to morning restores all 3 delivered commissions; undo is correctly unavailable after reload/scene switch.
Rules dialog opens and closes; initial and completed desktop layout visually inspected.

Coordinator independently completed rainy and dusk scenarios through actual UI at 09:22–09:24 UTC: all six remaining orders 100/100; each terminal result average 100, 9 stems remaining, no shopping. All three scenarios now browser-completed.
limits: Responsive CSS implemented at 1150, 940 and 650 px; a narrow physical/mobile viewport was not separately browser-emulated.
Browser logs contained extension-origin metadata errors; no app-origin error was observed in the captured results.
